definitions.c: Authenticated captured candidate binary64 prewrite value for one of21 stored-failure cells.
definitions.s: Candidate stored binary32 value, exactly lifted to a real value; existing saved checks establish RN32(c)=s.
definitions.r: Publisher reference stored binary32 value exactly lifted to a real value. It is not authenticated publisher pre-cast output.
definitions.t: Unchanged fixed absolute tolerance1e-5 W/m2, rtol0; strict stored failure when |s-r|>t.
definitions.I_closure: For the saved finite positive normal reference values, r_minus and r_plus are adjacent binary32 numbers. L=(r_minus+r)/2; U=(r+r_plus)/2; I_closure(r)=[L,U].
definitions.nearest_even_boundary_caveat: This closed interval is the closure of the round-to-nearest-even preimage, a conservative closed cell. Both endpoints round to r only when the binary32 significand of r is even; for odd significands the exact tie endpoints round to the adjacent even numbers. Calling every endpoint an actual preimage without parity qualification is incorrect.
definitions.rounding_assumption: x in the nearest-even cell is conditional on a correctly rounded final binary32 serialization without an additional transform/quantizer. Publisher exact pre-cast precision/rounding/pipeline is not independently authenticated here.
definitions.dmin: infimum over x in the admissible cell of |c-x|; using the closed hull gives max(L-c,0,c-U).
definitions.dmax: supremum over x in the admissible cell of |c-x|; using the closed hull gives max(|c-L|,|c-U|).
definitions.robust_straddle: dmin<t<dmax implies admissible interior points on both sides of the strict threshold under the stated rounding assumption. Strict inequality avoids an endpoint/tie ambiguity. If either bound equals t, endpoint inclusion/discrete pre-cast format must be handled explicitly.

scientific_interpretation.all21_straddle: Parent reports dmin/dmax straddling for all21 cells. This review establishes its mathematical interpretation, not an independent re-computation of21 raw payloads or a new executed precision classifier.
scientific_interpretation.meaning: For each cell the stored reference alone permits pre-cast candidates that would satisfy |c-x|<=t and others that would fail it. Thus the stored reference cannot identify whether the actual publisher pre-cast comparison passed or failed for that cell.
scientific_interpretation.no_statistical_claim: The interval is representational uncertainty conditional on rounding, not a probability distribution, confidence interval, or permission to assume a favorable x. Cells can be correlated by a shared solver; per-cell possible choices do not demonstrate a jointly realizable publisher run.
scientific_interpretation.14_and7: 14 is the mixed c-versus-r failure count. Seven are candidate-side storage threshold crossings when r is held fixed. Neither is a demonstrated native-versus-native error decomposition or attribution of publisher differences to candidate/reference serialization.
scientific_interpretation.outside_I_all21: c outside the reference closed rounding cell excludes c as an identical nearest-even pre-cast value producing r, under the rounding assumption. It does not establish |c-x|>t; distance to the cell can remain below t.
scientific_interpretation.physical_authority: No claim about RTE physical accuracy, publisher scientific validity, flux normalization, solar/data choice or production acceptance follows from these representational bounds.
